# FlintRay

> FlintRay shows companies what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity tell their buyers, which companies get recommended and why, then works the fixes until the company is in the answer.

- Method: each buyer situation runs as a three-turn conversation (the problem, the constraints, then "which companies would you contact?") in all four assistants, in the apps buyers use. The model behind every answer and the pages it read are recorded. A company counts as recommended only when the assistant's own words name it.
- Free audit: a selective sample of the buyer's market. 15 buyer situations, three turns each, four assistants, a private report and a walkthrough call.
- Audit and fix: a one-time project. The full set of buyer situations, a fix plan, FlintRay makes the fixes, and a rerun shows whether they worked. Priced as a project.
- Lens Monitor: self-serve, custom scope. FlintRay reruns the situations on a schedule and keeps a live report with sources and a fix plan; the client's team makes the changes.
- Lens Engage: managed, custom scope. Weekly reruns, and FlintRay writes and places the fixes.
- Data access: included with Lens Monitor and Lens Engage. The client connects their own AI assistant to the evidence (through MCP).
- Partners: white-label delivery under a partner's brand. Private quote.
